LIST.TITLE: AI Agent
LIST.SUBTITLE: Build, train and supervise the AI agents that talk with your customers.
LIST.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: The AI Agent puts an autonomous assistant on your WhatsApp in minutes. Pick a role, teach it about your business and let it qualify leads, answer support and even close deals on its own.

IDENTITY.LABEL: Identity
IDENTITY.TITLE: Step 1 of 5 · Identity
IDENTITY.HEADING: Who is your agent?
IDENTITY.HELPER: Give it a name, a role and a short description so your team recognises it.

PERSONALITY.LABEL: Personality
PERSONALITY.TITLE: Step 2 of 5 · Personality
PERSONALITY.HEADING: How should it talk?
PERSONALITY.HELPER: Pick the tone, the underlying model and write the system prompt that defines its behavior.

KNOWLEDGE.LABEL: Knowledge
KNOWLEDGE.TITLE: Step 3 of 5 · Knowledge
KNOWLEDGE.HEADING: Teach it about your business
KNOWLEDGE.HELPER: Add catalogue, FAQs, sales playbooks. You can skip this step and add later.

BEHAVIOR.LABEL: Behavior
BEHAVIOR.TITLE: Step 4 of 5 · Behavior
BEHAVIOR.HEADING: Set the guardrails
BEHAVIOR.HELPER: Decide if it can reply on its own and which words hand the conversation back to a human.

REVIEW.LABEL: Review
REVIEW.TITLE: Step 5 of 5 · Review
REVIEW.HEADING: Ready to launch?
REVIEW.HELPER: Review the configuration before creating the agent.

IDENTITY.NAME_REQUIRED: Tell us your agent's name to continue.
IDENTITY.DISPLAY_NAME_HINT: Who the customer sees the reply coming from, the same way a human agent's name appears above theirs. Leave empty to keep sending anonymously.
IDENTITY.DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: What does this agent do? Who is it for?

PERSONALITY.PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER: Describe how the agent should behave, what it can promise and what it must avoid.
PERSONALITY.PROMPT_HINT: Pick a tone above to load a starter template, then tweak.
PERSONALITY.API_KEY_HINT: Leave empty to use the platform pooled key.

KNOWLEDGE.CONTENT_PLACEHOLDER: Paste the raw knowledge here. URLs and files can be added later.

BEHAVIOR.AUTOPILOT_HINT: The agent will reply on its own as soon as a message arrives. You can also toggle this per conversation later.
BEHAVIOR.SPLIT_HINT: Instead of one block with line breaks, the agent sends each part as a separate message — the way a person types.
BEHAVIOR.REPLY_MARK_HINT: The reply arrives quoting what the customer asked for. A plain "ok", a thank-you or a greeting is answered without the quote, so the arrow stays meaningful.
BEHAVIOR.VOICE_HINT: When the customer asks to talk by voice, the agent answers with a voice note. Uses AI credits like every other AI action.
BEHAVIOR.STOP_WORDS_HINT: If the customer types any of these, the bot will hand the conversation to a human.
BEHAVIOR.SKIP_GROUPS_HINT: A group is people talking to each other, not a customer talking to the shop: the agent cannot tell which messages are meant for it. On by default.

REVIEW.HELPER: You can come back to edit prompts, knowledge and guardrails any time.

TEMPLATE.LABEL: Start from a template
TEMPLATE.HELP: Pick your kind of business. The instructions and starter documents come ready, and you adjust whatever you want.

EDIT.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this agent? This cannot be undone.
EDIT.ACTIVE_HINT: Disable to stop the agent from being used without deleting it.
EDIT.REPLACE_API_KEY_PLACEHOLDER: Leave empty to keep the current one
EDIT.REPLACE_API_KEY_HINT: The current key is never displayed. Fill only to replace it.
EDIT.KNOWLEDGE_SOON_HINT: Upload files, URLs and FAQs here soon. For now use the wizard to add knowledge.
EDIT.ACTIVITY_SOON_HINT: Detailed conversation, token and cost charts coming soon. Summary for now:

SECTIONS.IDENTITY_HINT: How the agent appears to your team.
SECTIONS.PERSONALITY_HINT: Model, tone and instructions that drive its replies.
SECTIONS.BEHAVIOR_HINT: Guardrails, stop words and operating mode.

KNOWLEDGE.TITLE: Knowledge base
KNOWLEDGE.SUBTITLE: Documents the AI consults to answer. Facts, catalog, policies.
KNOWLEDGE.EMPTY: No knowledge yet. Add your first document.
KNOWLEDGE.DELETE_CONFIRM: Remove this knowledge? This cannot be undone.

BUSINESS.TITLE: Business setup
BUSINESS.SUBTITLE: What the agent needs before it can offer a time: what your agenda is called, when you are open, what you sell, and how far it may go on its own.
BUSINESS.SAVE_FAILED: Could not save. Check the opening hours.
BUSINESS.INCOMPLETE: Almost there. The agent only starts offering times once the agenda has a name, the week is filled in and there is at least one service.
BUSINESS.AGENDA_HINT: This name goes on the Google event and is how the customer hears the professional named.
BUSINESS.HOURS_HINT: Tick the days you are open. Stop for lunch? Add two ranges on the same day.
BUSINESS.SERVICES_HINT: Duration is what holds the chair. The buffer is the time to clean up and welcome the next person.
BUSINESS.SERVICES_EMPTY: No services yet. Without one the agent has nothing to book.
BUSINESS.RULES_TITLE: How far the agent goes alone
BUSINESS.LEAD_HINT: Nothing sooner. Someone booking for 20 minutes from now finds nobody ready.
BUSINESS.HORIZON_HINT: And nothing further out, or somebody books for March.
BUSINESS.CANCEL_WINDOW_HINT: Too close to the time the agent stops touching it: it explains and hands over to a human.

CALENDAR.TITLE: Google Calendar
CALENDAR.SUBTITLE: Connect your business calendar and the agent starts booking, rescheduling and cancelling right in the conversation.
CALENDAR.CONNECTED: Calendar connected. Now set up your business.
CALENDAR.CONNECT_FAILED: Could not connect the calendar. Try again.
CALENDAR.NOT_CONFIGURED: Google credentials have not been configured yet. Add them in Super Admin, under Google Calendar (they are separate from the Google login keys).
CALENDAR.DISCONNECTED: Calendar disconnected. Appointments already booked stay in your Google.

ERRORS.NO_REFRESH_TOKEN: Google did not return offline access. Connect again and accept every permission on the Google screen.
ERRORS.INVALID_STATE: The connection request expired. Click Connect again.

CALENDAR.BLOCKED: Blocked: this agent is using the belezaki agenda.

BELEZAKI.TITLE: belezaki
BELEZAKI.SUBTITLE: Already on belezaki? Connect and the agent books straight into the salon's real agenda. Services, prices, professionals and hours stay configured there.
BELEZAKI.CONNECTED: Salon connected. The agent can book now.
BELEZAKI.DISCONNECTED: Salon disconnected. Appointments already made stay in the belezaki agenda.
BELEZAKI.LAST_FAILURE: The agenda did not answer on the last attempt. If it keeps happening, contact support.
BELEZAKI.DROPPED: The connection to the salon was dropped. Connect again so the agent can book.
BELEZAKI.ONLY_ONE: We support one agenda integration at a time.
BELEZAKI.ONLY_ONE_BODY: This agent is using Google Calendar. Disconnect it to connect belezaki instead.

ERRORS.NOT_LINKED: Your account is not linked to a belezaki salon. Link it in belezaki and try again.
ERRORS.NOT_CONFIGURED: The belezaki integration is not configured on the server. Our team has been notified.
ERRORS.AGENDA_TAKEN: This agent already has an agenda connected.
ERRORS.PROBE_FAILED: We could not reach belezaki right now. Try again in a moment.

INTEGRATIONS.TITLE: Integrations
INTEGRATIONS.SUBTITLE: Connect the agent to your own APIs. It searches and acts mid-conversation — for example, look up real products and build a checkout cart for the customer.
INTEGRATIONS.EMPTY: No integrations yet. Connect the agent to an external API — a product catalog, a cart builder, an order lookup.

DESCRIPTION.LABEL: Description (the agent uses this to decide when to call it)
DESCRIPTION.PLACEHOLDER: Searches real products in the store: name, price, stock.

ENDPOINT.LABEL: Endpoint URL
ENDPOINT.HINT: Insert parameters into the URL with {'{{'} name {'}}'}. For search terms, add the url_encode filter.

AUTH.EDIT_HINT: For security, credentials are never shown. Fill them only if you want to change them.

PARAMS.LABEL: Parameters
PARAMS.HELP: What the agent fills in when it calls the tool.

REQUEST_TEMPLATE.LABEL: Request body template (optional)
REQUEST_TEMPLATE.PLACEHOLDER: Leave empty to send the parameters as JSON.

RESPONSE_TEMPLATE.LABEL: Response template (optional)
RESPONSE_TEMPLATE.PLACEHOLDER: Leave empty to return the raw response.

PLAYGROUND.TITLE: Test the agent
PLAYGROUND.HINT: Chat as if you were the customer. This is the same agent that answers on WhatsApp, with the same knowledge base, so what you see here is what a customer would see. This conversation never shows up in your inbox and nothing is sent to anyone.
PLAYGROUND.EMPTY: Send the first message, the way a customer would.
PLAYGROUND.PLACEHOLDER: Write as a customer. e.g. how much does it cost?
PLAYGROUND.TIMEOUT: The agent did not answer in time. Check the Activity tab or try again.
PLAYGROUND.ERROR: Could not generate a reply right now. Try again.

STATUS.ungrounded_claim: The agent stayed silent: it tried to state a value that is not in the knowledge base. Add that fact under Knowledge so it can answer.
STATUS.loop_suppressed: The agent stayed silent: the reply would repeat something it already said in this conversation.
STATUS.promise_unfulfilled: The agent stayed silent: the reply promised to go and check something without calling any tool, and it has no later message to keep that promise in. Check that a connected tool actually covers what was asked.
STATUS.booking_unperformed: The agent stayed silent: the reply confirmed an appointment that no tool ever made. Nothing was booked on the agenda, which is exactly why the reply was withheld.

ANALYTICS.TITLE: Agent performance
ANALYTICS.SUBTITLE: Measured numbers from this agent real calls, not estimates.
ANALYTICS.EMPTY: This agent has not replied yet. Numbers show up here as soon as it answers.
ANALYTICS.RECENT_EMPTY: Replies sent from now on show up here with their text, cost and time.

REVIEW.TITLE: Review
REVIEW.SUBTITLE: Follow what your agent answered, see where the automatic checks flagged a problem, and fix what needs fixing. Every correction takes effect on the next conversation.
REVIEW.CORRECTION_PLACEHOLDER: Write the right answer, exactly as the customer should have received it.
REVIEW.WILL_APPLY_NOW: This becomes agent knowledge now. The next customer gets the correct version.
REVIEW.WILL_WAIT_VERSION: Tone is taught by example. It is recorded and goes into a new agent version, tested before going live.
REVIEW.RECORDED_IDEAL: You marked this as an ideal example.

LAB.TITLE: Lab
LAB.SUBTITLE: Test a new version of your agent against real questions it already answered. Compare the replies side by side, pick the better one and activate it — no risk, nothing is sent to customers.
LAB.DRAFT_HELP: The new version starts from the instructions that are live today plus the replies you marked as ideal. Edit only what you want to change.
LAB.DRAFT_PLACEHOLDER: Leave blank to copy the current instructions.
LAB.EMPTY: Create a new version to start testing.
LAB.NO_DUELS: No comparisons yet. Click “Run test” so the agent answers real questions with the new version.

RADAR.TITLE: Commercial radar
RADAR.SUBTITLE: Conversations that ended without a sale, scored by how worth chasing they are. And, next to the cost, what the agent brought back.
RADAR.FOLLOW_UP_HELP: The message goes out through the same campaign pipeline, with randomised intervals and a daily cap, so the number does not get burned.
RADAR.FOLLOW_UP_PLACEHOLDER: Hi! Just checking whether you are still interested...
RADAR.EMPTY: No open opportunities. When a conversation ends without a sale, it shows up here.
RADAR.THEMES_HELP: What customers repeat. Every term here is a page you have not written or a product you do not stock.
